name: Supported Empirical Finding
claim: Consensus checks across multi-agent pipelines reduce factual hallucination by 42%.
source_text: Our empirical evaluations across 500 reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that multi-agent consensus checks reduce factual hallucination by 42% compared to single-agent baselines.

name: Partially Supported Scope
claim: Autonomous agent frameworks eliminate all software bugs during code generation.
source_text: Autonomous agent frameworks caught 65% of common syntax and logic errors in automated unit tests, though subtle architectural bugs persisted.

name: Unsupported Extrapolation
claim: Global spending on generative AI surpassed 500 billion dollars in the first quarter of 2024.
source_text: Enterprises allocated approximately 15 billion dollars to experimental generative AI tooling in early 2024.

name: Direct Contradiction Across Sources
claim: Quantum annealing models achieved quantum supremacy in linear programming tasks in 2023.
source_text: Peer-reviewed analysis confirmed that classical supercomputers outperformed the tested quantum annealers by 3x on identical linear programming benchmarks in 2023.

name: Subjective / Opinion Statement
claim: In our view, collaborative AI tools will fundamentally transform the nature of journalism in the coming decade.
source_text: The report discusses adoption curves among newsrooms.
